digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Tuesday, November 17. Amazon Connect's Wave 2 support bridge anchors a day of seven meetings, with no carried-over items or active reminders. First resolve coverage for its overlaps with the CM CoE/Product touchpoint and EPMO team leads, then check EKM's at-risk dependencies and review the MHE approval drafts. Incident Response is now on hold pending an ELT decision.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - Jhara 1:1 and slide preparation
items.detail: Review portfolio roadblocks and next steps with Jhara, then use the 11:00 AM focus block for EPMO weekly slides.

items.label: 11:30 AM-3:15 PM - Amazon Connect Wave 2 support bridge
items.detail: The bridge overlaps CM CoE/Product at 11:30 AM, blocked space at noon, and EPMO team leads at 2:00 PM. Agree on coverage; the daily standup was cancelled for the rollout.

items.label: 3:30-5:00 PM - Nicolas, CM CoE alignment, and Maria
items.detail: Use the Nicolas 1:1 for EKM risks; the Phase 1 and 2 alignment and Maria 1:1 follow back-to-back.

items.label: Set coverage for the Wave 2 rollout conflicts
items.detail: Confirm who will cover the Product touchpoint and team-lead meeting while the support bridge runs. Thiago proposed sequential activation of Intake Support, Tier 2 CS, and Paralegal, with validation before each queue; technical and activation coverage still needed confirmation.

items.label: Review EKM dependencies with Nicolas
items.detail: The project is at risk but preparation continues. Clarify the IT perspective, approval workflow, governance ownership, Salesforce readiness, and Legal review capacity before the next status update.

items.label: Review MHE expansion approval drafts
items.detail: Review the drafts relevant to your area and send approval or comments by Thursday, November 19. The sender will treat silence as approval; provider responses and the candidate list also affect Friday's pilot decision.

items.label: Clarify Universal Intake project leadership
items.detail: The kickoff chat asks who will be the project lead and sponsor. Frank is listed as the business analyst in the assignment notice; confirm the remaining leadership roles.

items.label: Wednesday - portfolio review and overlapping afternoon meetings
items.detail: The BD portfolio review is at 1:30 PM. LeadUp Module 4 and the EPMO team meeting both start at 3:00 PM, while Laura's 1:1 begins at 3:30 PM; confirm coverage or reschedule. The LeadUp invitation says only one of the two offered sessions is required.
